topics_to_cover: Sequences & Series: Definition, Monotonic sequences, Bounded sequences
roadmap.learning_outcome: Understand basic concepts of sequences and series

topics_to_cover: Convergent and Divergent Sequences, Infinite series, Oscillating and Geometric series
roadmap.learning_outcome: Identify types of sequences and series

topics_to_cover: Convergence, nth Term test, Integral test, Comparison Test, Limit Comparison test
Ratio test, Root test, Alternating series, Absolute and Conditional convergence, Leibnitz test
roadmap.learning_outcome: Analyze convergence of series using various tests

topics_to_cover: Limit Continuity and differentiability of functions of two variables, Euler's theorem for homogeneous equations
roadmap.learning_outcome: Understand multivariable functions and Euler's theorem

topics_to_cover: Tangent plane and normal. Change of variables, chain rule, Jacobians, Taylor's Theorem for two variables
Extrema of functions of two or more variables, Lagrange's method of undetermined multipliers
Review of curve tracing, Double and Triple integrals
Change of order of integration. Change of variables. Gamma and Beta functions, Dirichlet's integral
Applications of Multiple integrals such as surface area, volumes
Differentiation of vectors, gradient, divergence, curl and their physical meaning
Identities involving gradient, divergence and curl Line and surface integrals Green's, Gauss and Stoke's theorem and their applications
roadmap.learning_outcome: Apply vector calculus to solve problems

topics_to_cover: Concept of probability, random variable and distribution function: discrete and continuous

roadmap.learning_outcome: Apply probability distributions to solve problems
